item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory determination that the authorized cooperation and assistance is necessary, thereby satisfying the legal predicate for providing that support; the legal consequence occurs in this segment upon the determination.","evidence":"I hereby determine that the cooperation and assistance authorized by section 2606(a) of that title is necessary"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretary of Defense or designee must later issue implementing regulations concerning the support, but the segment does not dictate a particular legally consequential regulatory outcome.","evidence":"shall issue regulations concerning such co-operation and support"}]}
